Results.ReviewText: I’ve owned multiple grills over the years both charcoal & gas. This is the best of them all. The meat cooks evenly across the entire cooking surface, it doesn’t stick to the grates, clean up is a snap, and the ignition actually works for longer than a couple weeks.

Results.ReviewText:
I wish companies would wait longer before asking customers for a review, especially on something like this; something used intermittently.  In any case, the several times I've used my Weber E-210, it has done just fine.   I replaced a 5yo, rusted out [everything under the lid in the hot box was gone] Char Broil 4-burner with this Weber 2-burner.

I assembled the grill myself and all went well.  I appreciate the nice instructions.  All parts were in the box and it took about 2 hours to complete.  I picked up the black lid as that is all the store had on the shelf.  Any of the other non-black lids were special order through the store website; however, I needed the grill sooner rather than later, so black lid it was.

I like the hanging propane tank gauge.  Only time will tell how well it holds up, (no pun intended).  The 2-burner grill area is just fine for my family of 3.  If you need more than 4-5 servings of food, I suggest looking at the E-310 or larger.

I like the folding shelves.  The store display made it look like only 1 shelf folded, but having both fold is a nice feature.  I don't need a side burner so this works out well.

The only rear downside I've experienced so far is a hot lid handle near the ends where it attaches to the lid.  The center is good to grab.  I've reminded myself several times, on the hand and arm, that the outsides of the handle can be hot. I'm sure with time, I'll learn how to navigate the handle to not touch the hot parts.

Overall, I am happy with my grill.  If Weber stands behind their 10 year warranty, that will make it that much fabulous.  I just need more on-time with the grill, so I hope the weather cooperates this summer.
Results.Title: So far so good, but I've only it for a month

I bought this just over two years ago and the store would not stand behind it for a return or exchange.  I was given Weber's customer service number #800-446-1071 and told to handle it myself if I wanted to try to get warranty.  I was on the phone with Weber customer service for nearly 2 hours just to get them to send me replacement parts.  They too do not accept returns or offer exchanges!  So instead I got somewhere between 10-15 parts shipped to me for us to then rebuild the grill again.  All parts that were deteriorating were the sides, base, shelves and internal working parts of the grill.  The hood and the grates were about the only thing that has held up.  I thought I was buying America quality for a higher price with a good warranty when I purchased Weber...I was wrong.  This grill was very expensive for the size ($400-500) range and I am extremely disappointed in the quality and lack of warranty.  Now I have to go spend 2+ hours reading instructions and trying to rebuild this grill.  

BTW -- I had to send them many pictures before they would even offer replacement parts.

46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
